capture: Forward from installation. Earliest validated pre-match packet with two identified starting keepers, named 90-minute Over half-lines, quote age <=10 minutes. First decision including a pass stays locked per native fixture across reschedules.
formula: (issued mean + frozen league/venue mean)/2; same NB2 alpha and odds gates as control
price: Best eligible quote on identical contracts. Source verification and incumbent mean, probability, selection, and no-bet parity required.
outcomes: Both verified 90-minute starters, exact kickoff, team/player IDs and agreement between save totals and events. Conflicts held.
primary: Paired Brier on four or more saves for both goalkeepers; require a .005 reduction, non-worse log loss and positive incremental profit per common fixture. Assess intervals by independent matchweek. Require Brier-delta 95% upper bound below zero and half-width <=.01 before a promotion discussion.
economic: 0.5u hypothetical per qualified fixture per arm. No-bets scored for calibration only. Review ROI, P/L and settled stake per arm separately.
